title: Looking at a few book pages together is listed at 18 months
summary: Most children look at a few pages in a book with a caregiver by about 18 months, CDC says.
body: CDC lists looking at a few pages in a book with you among 18-month social milestones. The shared look is joint attention on a page, not a reading score. Most means 75 percent or more. The page says the materials are not a validated screening tool. A textbook line that toddlers point at pictures in books is a wider age window and a different source.
